methods.join: group_id plus selected/reference state, never OOF fold-local row number
methods.oracle: best allowed action with existing no-stay restriction; selected action never changed
methods.units: integer halted-vehicle-seconds; lane count read from original controlled network connections
methods.coverage: train-only standardized physical-state and state/action-contrast RMS distance; calendar/topology-only state columns and model score metadata excluded
methods.calibration: training nearest distances excluding entire same simulator seed; distinct training groups for neighbor labels
methods.display_strata: training distance percentiles <=50, 50..95, >95; descriptive only, no new policy gate
methods.aggregation: original demand/seed rosters; per-group records stay server-side
methods.interpretation: sparse-support and conflicting local labels are descriptive associations, not proof that more labels or another model will improve control
